title: Applications are invited for the post of Project Coordinator.

source.name: Department of Gandhian and Peace Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh

text:
KEY LINES:
a) Qualification:
Educational Qualification (Please attach one set of attested copies)

FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research Project
entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”. Posts is initially for one year or till the tenure of
project whichever is earlier. Post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post 1: Project Coordinator (No. of Posts: 1)
a) Qualification:
Essential: .ME/M.Tech/M.Sc in Environment Engineering/ Environment Science/Atmospheric Sciences/
Agricultural Science or Engineering/ allied discipline from a recognized institution/ University
 Candidate should have minimum 02 year of research experience in the field of climate
change / Air pollution & Public Health
Desirable:
 Have published minimum 2 paper in indexed journal
b) Salary: Rs. 80000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description:
 A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having experience and
research record in climate change and air pollution studies.
 The candidate should have ability to converse, make presentations, write academic papers,
reports and collaborate with interdisciplinary colleagues and researchers.
 The candidate is expected to assist with the organization of workshops, meetings, outreach
activities, and general management of the project as a whole.
 The candidates should have an experience in handing the large datasets.
Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience, publications etc should
reach to the undersigned latest by 14 October 2023 before 2.00 pm in room no 227, Department of Environment
Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/DK1riqm3CgKgEiz78 before submitting
application with document through email. The interview date and time will be informed through email to
shortlisted candidates. Interview may be held online/offline. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The
rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency will govern the selected
candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator
E-mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
